integrity: The claim is derived directly from the printed vector field. Stability orientation is stated in physical forward time; a negative time rescaling is treated only as an orbit-equivalence and not as a stability-preserving transformation.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the critical surface \(m=a(1-D_2/(1+D_1))\) with \(0<a<1-D_2/(1+D_1)\); it does not analyze the distinct positive saddle-node at \(m=m^*\) or re-prove the full global phase portrait.
title: Exact threshold drift fixes the positive-quadrant saddle-node orientation
